title: 消息流简约/详细双模式与类型化图片画廊

root_cause.message_mode: The existing activity fold unconditionally shadowed the pinned priority-zero assistant-step, tool-call and context node renderers, so users could not select the pinned native detailed projection.
root_cause.setting: The Shell had the pinned client settingsScope seam but no Host-registered e-mate messageFlowMode schema, so there was no native persisted owner for the presentation policy.
root_cause.image_revision: Every durable image receipt previously matched as a start for one call-derived node id. A T05 revision-3 review update could therefore attempt a duplicate start instead of updating the existing gallery node.
root_cause.duplicate_gallery_path: The Shell also registered an assistant-message DOM gallery mover alongside the durable receipt/native Tool-result gallery. Removing that registration leaves one typed gallery node path and does not hide or rewrite the native Tool result.

resolution.native_setting: The Host registers one inline Schemastery namespace e-mate with messageFlowMode. Missing and damaged values normalize to simple; detailed is the only other retained value. The client binds that namespace through the pinned settingsScope and mutates only its native field.
resolution.presentation_policy: Simple dynamically registers the existing three priority-minus-one activity-fold shadows. Detailed disposes only those shadows, exposing the already-registered pinned priority-zero assistant-step, tool-call and context renderers directly. Live changes reuse the same chat store, events and node sequence.
resolution.branding: ThinkingStatusBranding remains registered independently of the message mode.
resolution.typed_gallery: The gallery parses the frozen T05 v2 receipt and its exact historical terminal form, treats revision 3 as an update to the same call-derived node, uses the native ImageGallery, deduplicates attachment ids within native Tool-result nodes and preserves the untouched Tool-result event/text.
resolution.single_gallery_owner: The old assistant-message DOM mover is no longer registered in client index. Default simple remains the activity-fold policy; image gallery ownership is not used as a fallback for message folding.
